author: __Chronus
body:
i was banned on this server 5 months ago and i tried to appeal, but they rejected my ban appeal. I knew it was best to wait a long time after because i knew that if i just appealed 1 week later they wouldn't un-ban me, and plus the staff members told me to wait atleast 3 months, but i forgot completed about this server, and now i want to be un-banned. im not gonna say that the staff on the server gave me infractions wrong because that would start something else, and plus i got banned for 20 infractions and that aint anything majour like advertising or using a hacked client. I hope that it is finally time for me to get back on the server.

Thank You :D

My Ingame name is CronicHD
